pages.text: Four rare cave biomes deep underground: dinosaurs in the $(l)Primordial Caves$(), the sugary $(l)Candy Cavity$(), the deep-sea $(l)Abyssal Chasm$() and the eerie $(l)Forlorn Hollows$().$(br2)They are hard to find. Look up $(l)Cave Tablet$() and $(l)Cave Codex$() in JEI to learn how to track them down.
